apps.localizedDescription: Omnia is a media player for your own Stremio add-ons, Live TV playlists, and Jellyfin or Emby servers. It hosts no content: everything you watch comes from sources you add yourself.

versions.localizedDescription:
Collections are easier to organise, card styles now work per device, the iPad got a proper layout, and signing out on one device no longer signs you out everywhere.

New
- Drag to reorder collections. Each collection is one tidy row with a drag handle and show, edit and remove buttons.
- Apply to All Cards. One button on the Poster Card Style page copies its look to Collections, their folders and Continue Watching. It replaces the confusing "Match Poster Card Style" options.
- Card styles per device. A size that suits a Mac no longer changes your iPhone. Turn on Same Style on All Devices if you'd rather share one set.
- Cards in Folders setting. Choose how titles look inside a collection folder.
- Home background blend. With Dynamic Background Color on, the hero fades into the artwork's colour and the rows below sit on it.
- Animated collection covers on iPhone and iPad.
- Keyboard control of the player on iPhone and iPad: arrows, space and Esc.
- Decoder and subtitle auto-sync settings on iPhone and iPad.

Improved
- iPad: the Home hero and rows run behind the sidebar, and the stream picker is a wider, taller sheet docked to the bottom.
- Collection folders open with portrait posters by default, as imported from Xperience, with three across on iPhone.
- Tapping or clicking outside a player menu closes it.
- Loading indicators are centred everywhere.
- Search answers sooner and remembers recent results.
- Starting a stream on iPhone or iPad uses one connection instead of two.
- Hero trailers and animated covers rest in Low Power Mode.
- Email fields no longer capitalise the first letter.

Fixed
- Signing out on one device no longer signs out your others.
- If a session ends on its own, Omnia now tells you and keeps your data on the device. It syncs again when you sign in.
- Keys and sign-ins added while signed out are added to your account when you sign in, and anything missing from a device is restored.
- Settings dropdowns stay beside their title instead of dropping below it.
- Long titles no longer shrink their poster.
- Discover rows say "Popular - Movies" and "Popular - Series" instead of two rows called "Popular".
- The metadata cache now works after you reopen the app.
- Trailers close when they end.

Security
- Add-on install links now ask before installing.
- Your sign-in stays on the device instead of moving through backups.
- Copied add-on links stay on the device and clear after two minutes on iPhone and iPad.
- Keys are no longer saved in the network cache or in logs.
- Sign Out also clears saved video frames and the failure log.
- Profile PIN lockouts survive quitting the app.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Omnia connects to Jellyfin or Emby servers on your local network.
